SETUP_CODE.description: Required. A one-time code Zomfy pairs with: make one with `openssl rand -hex 16` and keep it for Settings → Bots → Relay.

DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID.description: Discord (optional): **General Information → Application ID** of your app at [discord.com/developers](https://discord.com/developers/applications). Leave empty to turn Discord off.

DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Discord: **General Information → Public Key** (64 hex characters).

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Discord: **Bot → Reset Token**. Turn on **Message Content Intent** on the same page.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Slack (optional): the **Bot User OAuth Token** (`xoxb-…`) of the app made from `apps/relay/slack-manifest.yaml` (README, "Slack"). Leave empty to turn Slack off.

SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Slack: **Basic Information → App Credentials → Signing Secret**.

EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Phone push notifications (a later phase): leave empty.
